description.purpose: One interactive canvas served over HTTP under the render cell's own path, drawing whatever its store holds. The first thing it draws is the colony itself.
description.use_when: An operator or a user should see and rearrange something the colony knows, in a browser, without an operator UI release for every new kind of object.
description.not_in_scope: It draws nothing the store does not hold. The topology snapshot arrives on a timer through the parent-granted `./probe -> /colony/graph` lane; without that lane the canvas is fed from outside and stays as fresh as whoever feeds it. No realtime push (a viewer sees a change when it joins or interacts, not when another viewer moves a box). No object library beyond cells, hives and edges.
examples: GET /surface/org/acme/member/alice/canvy/render -> the colony as boxes and lines, draggable
refresh (timer) -> probe -> /colony/graph -> probe -> store: one snapshot row
socket event node:moved -> render -> store -> render -> the browser
